_meta.purpose: Project registry for Twomi Design Agent. Each project = a feature/initiative with its own set of screens. Used to (1) route Figma output to a dedicated page (Phase 1, PR #28), (2) scope which schemas / library-dict entries get loaded at generation time (Phase 2-3, PR #29), (3) populate UI dropdown.
_meta.back_compat: When a project is missing from this list, the agent still accepts it as a free-text value and treats it as untagged (loads all schemas / dict entries). Adding to this registry only enables strict scoping and dropdown autocomplete.
